items.name: Award Compliance & Financial Overview Extraction
items.description: Uploads a federal award notice or agreement and returns a single structured JSON object covering both the compliance framework (Uniform Guidance applicability, RTC, financial reporting, progress reporting, prior approvals, budget modification rules, property, deliverables, high-risk conditions, compliance calendar) and the financial management structure (total award amount, budget periods, cost share, F&A rate and base, performance period, budget categories, FFR, audit, record retention). Output conforms to the award-compliance-extraction-udm component schema. The runtime mirrors the ui-insight/ProcessMapping award-compliance-extraction workflow (two parallel Extraction tasks plus a Consolidation Prompt).

data.name: extract-compliance-framework
data.prompt:
You are extracting the compliance framework from a federal
award document: Uniform Guidance applicability, RTC
applicability, financial and progress reporting requirements,
prior-approval categories, budget modification restrictions,
property requirements, deliverable requirements, high-risk
conditions, and a consolidated compliance calendar.

Be 100% accurate. For each searchset item, return the value as
the document states it. Use null for missing scalars and empty
arrays for missing lists; never invent values.

prior_approval_requirements is a categorized list of approval
types only — the procedural mechanics (threshold, timeline,
consequences) live in the prior-approval-extraction-udm
component. Do not duplicate that work here.

compliance_calendar is the consolidated deadline view. Pull
every recurring or fixed deadline mentioned across the document
(FFR, progress reports, equipment inventory, audit submission,
RTC milestones) and emit one row per deadline with
{requirement_type, deadline, responsible_party, consequences}.

items.searchphrase: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance applicability details.
items.title: uniform_guidance_applicability

items.searchphrase: Research Terms and Conditions applicability.
items.title: rtc_applicability

items.searchphrase: Financial reporting frequency, deadlines, and systems.
items.title: financial_reporting_requirements

items.searchphrase: Progress report type, frequency, and format.
items.title: progress_reporting_requirements

items.searchphrase: Categorized list of prior-approval requirements (one entry per approval type).
items.title: prior_approval_requirements

items.searchphrase: Budget modification restrictions and re-budgeting rules.
items.title: budget_modification_restrictions

items.searchphrase: Equipment and property management requirements.
items.title: property_requirements

items.searchphrase: Deliverable requirements and deadlines.
items.title: deliverable_requirements

items.searchphrase: Enhanced monitoring, additional reporting, or specific restrictions tied to risk classification. Empty array when not high-risk.
items.title: high_risk_conditions

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {requirement_type, deadline, responsible_party, consequences}, one row per recurring or fixed deadline pulled from across the document.
items.title: compliance_calendar

data.name: extract-financial-management
data.prompt:
You are extracting the financial management structure from a
federal award document: total award amount, multi-year budget
periods, cost share, F&A rate and base, performance period,
budget categories, FFR cadence, audit requirements, and record
retention.

Be 100% accurate. Match the schema's type for each field
exactly:
  - Number-typed fields (total_award_amount,
    budget_period_amounts[].amount, budget_categories[].approved_amount)
    are JSON numbers — no quotes, no currency symbol, no
    thousand-separators. "$1,234,567.89" in the document
    becomes 1234567.89 in JSON.
  - String-typed fields (cost_share_requirements, fa_rate,
    fa_rate_base, performance_period, ffr_requirements, etc.)
    are quoted verbatim — preserve currency symbols, percent
    signs, and date format.
Use null for missing scalars and empty arrays for missing
lists.

budget_period_amounts is empty for single-period awards. The
sum across budget_period_amounts should reconcile to
total_award_amount (cross-field check CFR-01).

fa_rate and fa_rate_base are two distinct STRING fields.
"42.5% MTDC" becomes fa_rate: "42.5%" (string, percent sign
preserved) and fa_rate_base: "MTDC".

For audit_requirements return one of: Single Audit, A-133,
Program-Specific Audit, Not applicable. For record_retention
return one of: 3 years, 5 years, 7 years, Per sponsor
requirements.

items.searchphrase: Total award amount as a JSON number (no quotes, no currency symbol, no thousand-separators). "$1,234,567" becomes 1234567.
items.title: total_award_amount

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {period, start_date, end_date, amount} for multi-year awards. amount is a JSON number; period / start_date / end_date are strings. Empty array for single-period awards.
items.title: budget_period_amounts

items.searchphrase: Cost sharing/matching requirements (amount and type).
items.title: cost_share_requirements

items.searchphrase: Indirect cost rate percentage as stated (e.g., "42.5%").
items.title: fa_rate

items.searchphrase: Base for F&A rate calculation (e.g., MTDC, TDC, Salary & Wages).
items.title: fa_rate_base

items.searchphrase: Period of performance dates as stated.
items.title: performance_period

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {category_name, approved_amount, restrictions, prior_approval_required} for each budget category. approved_amount is a JSON number; the others are strings or boolean.
items.title: budget_categories

items.searchphrase: Federal Financial Report frequency and deadlines.
items.title: ffr_requirements

items.searchphrase: Audit requirements (Single Audit, A-133, Program-Specific Audit, Not applicable).
items.title: audit_requirements

items.searchphrase: Record retention requirements (3 years, 5 years, 7 years, Per sponsor requirements).
items.title: record_retention

data.name: award-compliance-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are assembling the Award Compliance & Financial Overview
extraction output. The input is the JSON fragment produced by
the upstream parallel Extraction tasks (compliance framework +
financial management). Your job is to emit a single JSON object
that validates against the award-compliance-extraction-udm@0.1.0
schema.

Top-level shape:
{
  "award_number": string|null,
  "compliance_framework": { ...10 keys... },
  "financial_management": { ...10 keys... }
}

Rules:
1. Pass the compliance framework fragment into
   compliance_framework verbatim. Pass the financial management
   fragment into financial_management verbatim.
2. award_number is a top-level scalar drawn from whichever
   fragment carries it; null when neither does.
3. audit_requirements and record_retention must use enum values
   exactly. Normalize document phrasings to the closest enum.
4. compliance_calendar must consolidate deadlines from across
   the document — if both fragments produced calendar entries,
   merge them, dedupe by (requirement_type, deadline) tuple,
   and preserve responsible_party and consequences from the
   more specific entry.
5. budget_period_amounts is an empty array for single-period
   awards. When non-empty, the sum should reconcile to
   total_award_amount (cross-field check CFR-01); flag in
   validation_plan if not.
6. Use null for missing scalar fields; never invent values.
7. Do not output any text outside the single JSON object.

validation_plan.check_description: Verify total_award_amount, budget_period_amounts, and budget_categories.approved_amount preserve the document's currency formatting and are valid numbers.
Verify performance_period and budget_period_amounts dates are well-formed and chronologically consistent.
Verify every recurring or fixed deadline mentioned across the document (FFR, progress reports, equipment inventory, audit) appears as a row in compliance_calendar.
